# Forrest's Field Tools

> Free, no-signup reference pages and calculators for pets, gardens, homesteads and off-grid living.

## Pet safe-food lists (vet-sourced)

- [What can hamsters eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/hamsters/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can guinea pigs eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/guinea-pigs/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can rabbits eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/rabbits/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can cats eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/cats/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can chickens eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/chickens/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can parrots eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/parrots/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can budgies eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/budgies/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can bearded dragons eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/bearded-dragons/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can ferrets eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/ferrets/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
- [What can tortoises eat?](https://fscholtesdowd.github.io/pet-safe-foods/tortoises/): safe, go-easy and never-feed foods with sources
